description: This file defines a custom React hook named useMindMap that manages state and logic for constructing and maintaining a roadmap visualization based on gap analysis data. It handles fetching data from API endpoints, managing loading/error states, and auto-initialization based on initial input.

methods.name: useMindMap({ initialGaps = null } = {})
methods.description: Custom React hook for managing roadmap data derived from gap analysis, supporting operations like building from gaps and ensuring analysis.
